scripts.init:frontend: pnpm i && pnpm run api:sync && pnpm run build:frontend
scripts.init: pnpm run init:backend && pnpm run init:frontend
scripts.lint: pnpm run lint:backend && pnpm run lint:frontend
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:backend && pnpm run typecheck:frontend
scripts.format:backend: uv run ruff format ./src/backend & uv run ruff format ./src/ocelescope
scripts.format: pnpm run format:frontend && pnpm run format:backend
scripts.api:sync: pnpm --filter @ocelescope/api-config run build && pnpm run api:generate && pnpm run build:frontend
scripts.docs:dev: uv sync --group docs && uv run mkdocs serve --livereload
scripts.docs:update: uv run scripts/update_plugins.py && uv run --package ocelescope pip freeze >> docs/data/pluginEnviroment.txt
scripts.dev:backend: uv run ocelescope-backend serve --reload --reload-dir src/backend/ --env-file src/backend/.env
scripts.dev:app: pnpm run dev:backend & pnpm run dev:frontend
scripts.notebook: uv run --with jupyterlab --with jupyter-ruff jupyter lab notebooks/
